gen-silkscreen-gf-lexend-peta: Retro and lo-fi up top, Silkscreen spaces its pixel letters out like spaghetti laid down in lines, while Lexend Peta keeps curves full. It reads easily.
gen-silkscreen-gf-lexend-tera: Lexend Tera is a single-weight sans-serif with open curves and letters spaced like stepping stones, set against Silkscreen's retro, lo-fi heading. They sit comfortably together.
gen-silkscreen-gf-lexend-zetta: Approachable in manner, Lexend Zetta draws tall-bodied small letters with widely tracked, ribbon-like strokes of constant width. Silkscreen's lo-fi, spaced-out heading then sits above it, shorter in lowercase height and far more playful.
gen-silkscreen-gf-montserrat-alternates: Contemporary and businesslike, Montserrat Alternates has a c as open as a bent paperclip and lowercase crowding the capital line. Long paragraphs stay smooth, and Silkscreen's lo-fi heading gives them a retro doorway.
gen-silkscreen-newsreader: Newsreader reads with authority, its open curves and restrained stem contrast drawn by a barely tilted calligraphy nib. Silkscreen's constant-width lines make the sharpest foil, a retro heading against a refined serif.
gen-silkscreen-source-serif-4: Source Serif 4 has a dignified look, with a gaping c and slight tightening where curves peak, like letters stamped in soft metal. But Silkscreen's constant blueprint line and generous spacing give the heading a lo-fi, retro feel.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-readex-pro: Metamorphous stands out for its large sidebearings and high midline, with a soft shift between fat and slim strokes. And Readex Pro follows in a steady weight, broad terminal gaps and crossbars as thick as its stems.
gen-special-elite-noto-serif: Noto Serif has a prominent x-height and a subtle thick-and-thin cadence that lends it a literary air across a page. Over many paragraphs it stays gentle.
gen-titan-one-archivo: Chunky, bright and loud. Titan One's single stroke width and towering midzone meet Archivo's outward-opening curves, and that jump from rounded heading to editorial plain sans is what makes the pair work.
gen-titan-one-fs-epilogue: Titan One is bold and playful, with a towering midzone and brush-lifted curve ends that earn their keep when big and short. Epilogue brings a wire-like monoline skeleton and curvy, tall-bodied lowercase.
